domain.title: Company domain
domain.description: Domain of the single company to analyze (e.g. "stripe.com"). Leave this blank if you're using the "Companies (multiple)" field below instead.

greenhouseSlug.title: Greenhouse slug (optional)
greenhouseSlug.description: Only used together with Company domain above. The company's identifier in its Greenhouse board URL, e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe -> "stripe".

leverSlug.title: Lever slug (optional)
leverSlug.description: Only used together with Company domain above. The company's identifier in its Lever board URL, e.g. https://jobs.lever.co/palantir -> "palantir".

companies.title: Companies (multiple)
companies.description: For analyzing a list of companies in one run instead of one at a time. One entry per company, `domain` is required, `greenhouseSlug`/`leverSlug` are optional. Ignored if Company domain above is filled in.

roleKeywords.title: Notable role keywords
roleKeywords.description: Open roles whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive) count as a stronger hiring signal. Leave empty to treat any open role the same.

fetchContactPage.title: Also fetch a linked contact/about page
fetchContactPage.description: If a link to a contact/about page is found on the homepage, fetch it too to improve contact-info coverage. Adds one extra request per company.
